questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The area under a velocity-time graph of a moving body gives its:
questions.explanation: Area = velocity × time, which is displacement. The slope of the same graph gives acceleration.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 2: Motion in a Straight Line

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The average kinetic energy of a molecule of an ideal gas is directly proportional to:
questions.explanation: Average kinetic energy per molecule is (3/2)kT, so it depends only on absolute temperature and not on the nature of the gas.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: In a purely inductive AC circuit, the current:
options: Is in phase with the voltage
Lags behind the voltage by π/2
Lags behind the voltage by π
questions.explanation: An inductor opposes any change of current, so the current lags the applied voltage by a quarter cycle and the average power consumed is zero.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The water molecule is bent rather than linear because the central oxygen atom is:
options: sp hybridised with no lone pair
sp² hybridised with one lone pair
sp³ hybridised with two lone pairs
questions.explanation: Oxygen in water is sp³ hybridised with two bond pairs and two lone pairs; lone pair repulsion pushes the bond angle down to about 104.5°.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 4: Chemical Bonding and Molecular Structure

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Lanthanoid contraction, the steady decrease in size along the lanthanoid series, is caused by:
questions.explanation: The diffuse 4f orbitals shield the outer electrons poorly, so the rising nuclear charge pulls them closer and the size shrinks steadily.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 12, Chapter 4: The d- and f-Block Elements

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The correct order of basic strength of methylamines in aqueous solution is:
questions.explanation: In water, basicity balances the +I effect, solvation of the cation and steric crowding. For methyl amines this gives 2° > 1° > 3° > ammonia.

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: In which of the following fruits is the edible part a fleshy thalamus rather than the pericarp?
questions.explanation: Apple is a false fruit or pome in which the thalamus grows fleshy and forms the edible portion, while the true fruit lies within.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 5: Morphology of Flowering Plants

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: Double fertilisation in angiosperms produces:
options: A zygote and the primary endosperm nucleus
questions.explanation: One male gamete fuses with the egg to give the diploid zygote (syngamy) and the other fuses with the two polar nuclei to give the triploid PEN (triple fusion).
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 1: Sexual Reproduction in Flowering Plants

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: The excretory organs of the earthworm Pheretima are:
questions.explanation: Earthworms excrete through segmentally arranged nephridia. Malpighian tubules belong to insects such as the cockroach.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 7: Structural Organisation in Animals

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Which part of the human brain acts as the main relay centre for sensory impulses travelling to the cerebrum?
questions.explanation: The thalamus sorts and relays almost all sensory input on its way to the cerebral cortex; the cerebellum instead handles balance and coordination.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 18: Neural Control and Coordination
